name: Renfray remembers Caer Darrow

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

summary: Tirion’s memory turns from the marks of duty to family excursions and an artist’s work. He sends the seeker to Caer Darrow, where his old friend Artist Renfray remains among the ruins. She painted the Fordring family in happier days. The island is now a quiet ruin in the lake, and Renfray is a ghost; the quest asks for a portrait, not a return to the life it preserves. Across years of exile, the canvas is a rare piece of the family’s past that has not vanished.
